name: g1rev2
note: A grasp is only useful if the cube visibly rises with the closed gripper: after close_gripper, lift straight up slowly 0.05 m and take a new observation; only if the green cube is at a higher Z, continue to the placement, otherwise return to the green cube, re-open and re-grasp. Move slowly: never rush the lateral transport; lower the cube gently onto the stack and open the gripper only when the cube rests on the red cube.
